category: Stremio addon (Arabic catalogs + private-tracker streams resolved through the user's own Real-Debrid or TorBox account)

free_tier.stated: Trial keys are issued by the Discord bot and are valid for 90 days; permanent keys are available to donors only and currently do not expire.
free_tier.notes: The byte volume is not the addon's: it is whatever the user's own debrid subscription allows.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the addon returns streams; the file size ceiling is the linked debrid account's.

retention.stated: not applicable: nothing is stored by the addon; cache retention is the debrid provider's.

egress.terms: Streams are played from the user's own Real-Debrid or TorBox account ('Streams are provided through your paid Real-Debrid or TorBox account'), so traffic is billed by that provider and not by Aradeb.

interface_detail: A Stremio addon endpoint configured at https://aradeb.518878.xyz; the Stremio client calls it over HTTP. Installation orders are distributed through the project's Discord.
tooling: Stremio desktop and mobile; a Discord bot for keys; no CLI and no API documentation beyond the addon protocol.
chaining: It is the Arabic-language layer on top of a global debrid subscription: the addon supplies Arabic catalogs and private-tracker sources, the debrid account supplies the bytes, and the client never buys a regional service.

limits.value: keys are issued by a Discord bot (90-day trials) and permanent access is donation-gated

limits_note: The listing warns the addon 'will not work properly unless it is installed correctly as explained in the Discord server', so the install channel is part of the access condition.
binding_note: No byte quota of its own exists; access is gated by a key that a human issues, and the key can expire while the debrid bill keeps running.

identity_cost.detail: A Discord account is required to reach the bot that issues keys; Discord signup itself takes an email. The addon has no separate registration.

reliability_note: Two dependencies must both hold: the debrid account's cache and the private trackers the addon queries. A trial key expires at 90 days, and permanent keys depend on a donation, so the addon can stop resolving for a user who is still paying a debrid subscription.
confidence_note: The feature list, the 90-day trial, the donor gating and the 4K claim were read on the addon's directory entry today. What would raise it: an installed addon returning a playable stream.

evidence.proved: Arabic catalogs, Latin and Arabic search, streams 'provided through your paid Real-Debrid or TorBox account' up to 4K, 90-day trial keys via a Discord bot, permanent keys for donors only, configure page aradeb.518878.xyz

price_per_tb_month: USD 0 for the addon; the Real-Debrid or TorBox subscription is the cost
notes: This is the clearest evidence that the Arabic market consumes retrieval through a global service rather than a local one: the local layer is an addon, and the paid account is Real-Debrid or TorBox. A separate 'Arab debrid service' was searched for and not found (see findings.md).
